One-variable Cauchy kernels have dense span in \(H^2(\mathbb C_+)_{\partial}\), and tensor products of dense factor sets are dense in the Hilbert tensor product. The opposite Hardy boundary space yields an infinite-dimensional orthogonal complement, proving properness and infinite codimension for every \(n\ge2\).
